what: Bio-Techne makes the reagents researchers use: proteins, antibodies and assay kits for laboratory experiments, plus instruments for analysing cells and genetic material.
customers: Academic and pharmaceutical research laboratories, and biotech companies developing drugs.
money: diagnostic reagents and spatial genomics instruments
moat: Catalogue reagents cited in published papers: once an experiment is validated with a particular antibody, researchers keep buying that exact one to keep results comparable.
risks: Revenue has been flat at $1.2B for three years as academic and biotech funding tightened
67 times earnings and 9 times sales for a business that is not currently growing
The analyst average target is slightly below the current price
opportunities: A 15.0% net margin and $308M of free cash flow
Reagents are consumables bought repeatedly, not equipment bought once
Spatial biology instruments are an emerging field where it has a strong position
watch: Organic revenue growth and whether academic funding stabilises.
